decisions.reason: Defining visual object type 2 does not change the review sequence or the required number of questions per level.
The visual representation definition does not alter how related levels support gradual or curriculum-block-based progression.
Specifying a visual object type does not change the rule for copying a question into each applicable level.
The source defines a visual representation and does not resolve or modify curriculum coverage or grade alignment.
The visual object definition does not resume or alter the deferred requirement for a constraint-compliant C# random generator.
